access.title: Access
access.statusPublic: Public – anyone with the link can see the menu.
access.statusProtected: Protected – guests need an access code.
access.help: With an access code (PIN) only guests who know the code can see the menu – e.g. for an event or staff menu. The code is stored encrypted only and cannot be shown again later. Every change signs out all guests. Monitors keep showing protected menus.
access.codeRules: 4–12 digits or letters (no spaces or special characters, case-insensitive). Digits only → guests get a numeric keypad.
access.removed: Access code removed – the menu is public again
access.qrHelp: Share the code conveniently via QR link (e.g. on table tents): the link contains the code and opens the menu directly. Enter the current code for it.
access.qrMismatch: The code does not match the stored access code.
access.qrFailed: Could not create the QR code
